title: Alaska, California Guard arrive on the East Coast ahead of Hurricane Florence
description: U.S. Air Force personnel from the Alaska and California Air National Guard unload vehicles, trailers and equipment from an AKANG 176th Wing C-17 Globemaster III airlift aircraft crewed by members of the 144th Airlift Squadron at Dover Air Force Base, Del., Sept. 13, 2018. Pararescue personnel from the AKANG’s 212th Rescue Squadron and CAANG’s 129th Rescue Wing are being staged in preparation for offering support to civil authorities as needed in response to hurricane relief operations. Run Time: 1:00.
